answer: The design leans on stake bond posted per identity, split across independent auditors, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The anchor of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. The fable is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the saffron. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
